pairs.subject: hitl-approval
pairs.evidence: apps/console/src/pages/review/Judge.tsx:44 The Review page is a look back at sandbox sessions that have already finished: the judge's verdict, the moderation records and the operator's line marks all come after the session ran, and nothing on the page waits for a human decision before an action happens. A case-insensitive grep of apps/console/src/pages/review/ for approv, consent, escalat and unattended found nothing, so the subject's gate machinery (trigger, pause state, continuation) has nothing here to govern.

techniques.evidence: apps/console/src/pages/review/Layer2.tsx:40 The 'gates' here are automated moderation stages, shown after they acted. The page has no human-driven gate state.

apps/console/src/pages/review/FeedbackPanel.tsx:15 A failed feedback write stays on screen with a retry, which matches the 'write must land' idea. But the marks are annotations, not verdicts on pending items, so this is not an approval queue.
apps/console/src/pages/review/FeedbackPanel.tsx:49 Saving a mark resumes nothing: there is no paused work waiting on it, so there is no continuation to design.

apps/console/src/pages/review/Layer2.tsx:125 An unmeasured check is shown as not-evaluable rather than passed, which is in the spirit of the rule. But no severity classifier routes pending items here.
apps/console/src/pages/review/Moderation.tsx:46 Moderation is listed as past records. Nothing on the page arms a gate over machine output, so there is no gate to need an oracle.
apps/console/src/pages/review/Judge.tsx:44 The judge grades a session after it ends. Its pass/fail admits nothing past a trust boundary in this context.
